title: The Best Zigbee Water Shutoff Valves
subtitle: Zigbee valve controllers that shut off your water automatically when a leak is found, ranked.
intro: We pulled the Zigbee water shutoff valves and valve controllers on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

buyers_guide.q: How does a smart water valve work?
buyers_guide.a: A motorized actuator turns your main water valve (or replaces it), so you can shut water off from your phone or automatically when a leak sensor gets wet.
Actuators that clamp onto an existing quarter-turn ball valve install without cutting a pipe. In-line valves need a plumber.
Z-Wave valves need a Z-Wave hub. Pair them with leak sensors on the same hub so a leak closes the valve automatically.
